$comment: Exponential Desktop's agent chat (#EDE-65 lane I): THE chat both hosts draw, the IDE's Agent page and conversation as one genUI document. The chat button next to the start button (or Super+Space) opens it as an on-demand top layer surface filling the panel (the ground's rounded panel: the shell sizes it like a maximised window, inside the sidebar's and the taskbar's exclusive zones plus the panel margin). It binds /chatting, the chat model (packages/uicore/fixtures/chat.json, uicore-model chat): face `home` = the agent row (To {name}, one circle per agent, the picked one ringed) over the composer; face `conversation` = the header (the agent's icon, the title, New chat), the rows (#EDE-65 lane O: every bubble is genUI's MessageBubble under the theme's recipe, the IDE's look: `side` out = the viewer's own right, `in` left with its `author` over it, its `time` inside, `href` = its `link`, the sender's `avatar` icon in a 32 px column LEFT of the bubble on an `indent`ed row (empty = its spacer; 8 px to the bubble, transcript-grouping `avatarGap`), so the bubble's 62 % cap is of the column right of it (`maxWidth.wide`), not of the row, a queued one at 0.7 with `queued` under it; each row's `gap` (3, 8, 12 or 16 px) is a spacer above it, the list itself has none; a `host` row is an Embed the host claims by its painted id and paints itself (the IDE's tool rows and Work card); the agent's plain prose in a transcript, muted lines, divider pills, cards that open their session (lane Q: a card with a genUI surface draws it in an Embed under its title, in the IDE's surface frame: the title caption over a 12 px card box; a plan keeps its row above the frame), questions whose options answer, pictures) and the composer. `noCli` (a Local desktop without a usable CLI) shows the empty state over the composer. The conversation composer's placeholder and busy are literal props (genUI binds only a Composer's value): the host sets them from /chatting/composer by id (`chat_composer`) and redraws when they change. THE `/` menu (domain::slash_menu, the IDE's rules): while the draft is a bare command token the host lists /chatMenu {open, rows [{name, command, description, hint, insert}]} above the composer (the session's CLI's builtins, then the team's prompts, both prefix-filtered; the home lists the prompts alone); a builtin's press (ede_chat slash {insert}) puts its insertion in the composer, never sends; a prompt's (ede_chat slash {prompt}) loads its body into it; every composer change reports the draft (ede_chat draft {text}). KEYS (#EDE-65 lane P, the IDE's composer menus): while /chatMenu is open the composer's menuKeys hands ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Tab/Escape to the host as the event ede_chat {action: key, key} (an event: its context carries the key); the host highlights one row (`selected`, domain::chat_document::menu_key): the arrows move it, wrapping, Enter and Tab pick it like its press, Escape shuts the menu for that draft; a rebuilt `/` menu keeps its row (clamped), the typeahead starts at its first. /chat/draft is the composer's text, owned by the document. ATTACHMENTS (#EDE-65 lane L, the IDE's composer rules): the composer's attach control (ede_chat attach) opens the desktop's file chooser; the picks stage as /chatFiles {open, items [{key, label, image, icon}]}, a removable Chip each above the composer (the image itself as its picture, else the file's glyph; ede_chat unattach {key}), images up to 4 × 10 MB and files up to 4 × 50 MB, one notice for the rest; the send uploads them (a team's session files, a Local desktop's blob store) and passes their ids with the text, a failed upload is the toast and keeps them for the retry. Everything goes through ede_chat {action}: send {text}, pick {agentId}, open {sessionId}, answer {messageId, answer}, new, stop; no action closes the surface. On a Local desktop the shell runs the desktop's own agent (#EDE-58); on a team it talks to the team's sessions through sessions.send.
